post.description:
Provisions an auto scaling group ("scale group"). The group launches between `min_nodes` and `max_nodes` identical nodes from the selected image and plan, and scales the running count automatically according to its scaling policies.

**At least one of `policy` (elastic) or `scheduled_policy` is required.**
- **Elastic `policy`** reacts to a metric (CPU, MEMORY, or a custom
  parameter). It is sent as two objects: a scale-up rule (`adjust: 1`) and a
  scale-down rule (`adjust: -1`).

- **Scheduled `scheduled_policy`** changes the target node count on a cron
  schedule. It is sent as two objects (scale-up and scale-down), where
  `scheduled_policy[0].adjust` <= `max_nodes`,
  `scheduled_policy[1].adjust` >= `min_nodes`, and
  `scheduled_policy[0].adjust` >= `scheduled_policy[1].adjust`.


A group can have at most `60` nodes (`MAX_NODES_PER_GROUP`). For a private cluster (`is_private: true`) send `custom_sku` and `host_ids` and a mandatory `vpc`, instead of `plan_id`. On success the group is returned in `Deploying` state - poll List or Detail until it is `Running`.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the project to scope the request to. Required integer project ID.
x-constraints: must be a valid integer project ID

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: API key used to authenticate the create request.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Region in which the group will be provisioned.
x-constraints: must be a valid region name (e.g., Delhi, Chennai)

schema.description: Create payload for an auto scaling group. Send `policy` for elastic (metric-based) scaling, `scheduled_policy` for cron-based scaling, or both - at least one is required. For a public group send `plan_id`; for a private cluster set `is_private: true` and send `custom_sku`, `host_ids` and a mandatory `vpc` instead.

name.description: Display name of the auto scaling group.

min_nodes.description: Minimum number of running nodes the group will maintain.

desired.description: Initial target number of running nodes. On create this equals min_nodes.
x-constraints: must be between min_nodes and max_nodes

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of running nodes the group may scale to.

plan_id.description: ID of the compute plan (SKU) backing each node. Required for a public group (is_private false).
x-constraints: must be a valid plan ID from Plan

sku_id.description: SKU identifier for the selected plan.

vm_image_id.description: ID of the image the nodes boot from.
x-constraints: must be a valid image ID

vm_template_id.description: Template ID of the selected image (its `template_id`).
x-constraints: must be a valid image template ID

my_account_sg_id.description: ID of the security group to attach to the group's nodes at create time.
x-constraints: must be a valid security group ID

vpc.description: VPC networks to attach to the group. Mandatory for a private cluster.

ipv4_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC.

is_e2e_vpc.description: Whether this is an E2E-managed VPC.

is_public_ip_required.description: Whether each node should be launched with a public IP.

isEncryptionEnabled.description: Whether to enable disk encryption on the nodes.

encryption_passphrase.description: Passphrase used for disk encryption. Required when isEncryptionEnabled is true.
x-constraints: must contain a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a special character

policy_type.description: Whether the elastic policy uses a Default metric (CPU/MEMORY) or a Custom parameter.

custom_parameter_name.description: Name of the custom scaling metric, when policy_type is Custom.

custom_parameter_value.description: Initial value of the custom metric. Sent as 0 at create time.

is_private.description: Whether to launch the group on a private (dedicated) cluster.

host_ids.description: IDs of the private-cluster hosts to place nodes on. Used when is_private is true.
x-constraints: used only when is_private is true

custom_sku.description: Custom node sizing for a private cluster. Used when is_private is true.

disk.description: Root disk size per node, in GB.

cluster_id.description: ID of the private cluster to launch on.

policy.description: Elastic (metric-based) scaling rules. Sent as two objects: a scale-up rule (adjust 1) and a scale-down rule (adjust -1).

type.description: Policy type. Always CHANGE for an elastic rule.

adjust.description: Node count change applied when the rule fires (positive to scale up, negative to scale down).

operator.description: Comparison operator between the metric and value.

value.description: Threshold the metric is compared against (a percentage for CPU/MEMORY).

period_number.description: Number of consecutive evaluation periods the condition must hold (watch period).

period.description: Length of each evaluation period, in seconds.

cooldown.description: Cooldown after a scaling action before the next one, in seconds.

scheduled_policy.description: Scheduled (cron-based) scaling rules. Sent as two objects: a scale-up and a scale-down target. scheduled_policy[0].adjust must be <= max_nodes, scheduled_policy[1].adjust must be >= min_nodes, and scheduled_policy[0].adjust must be >= scheduled_policy[1].adjust.

type.description: Policy type. Always CARDINALITY for a scheduled rule.

adjust.description: Target number of running nodes when the schedule fires.

recurrence.description: Cron expression for when the rule fires.
x-constraints: must be a valid cron expression
the two scheduled rules must use distinct crons
